title: 1 · Onesa traveller carries a signed IPS
description: Before Sefa leaves, Onesa's issuer assembles their International Patient Summary (problems, medicines, allergies) and signs it with a Document Signer Certificate, as a Verifiable Health Link (HCERT) or SMART Health Link. Sefa's health wallet holds it and can show it as a QR code.

Technology shown as simple oversized icons: a phone with a QR code, a shield with a check mark, a key. No readable text, no logos, no real brands. Flags only of the fictional countries: Onesa (indigo over orange, white star) and Taifafeki (teal, gold sun and gold bar). All people are fictional.

steps.title: Onesa traveller carries a signed IPS
steps.headline: Onesa's issuer signs Sefa's International Patient Summary, and Sefa carries it in their wallet as a QR code.
steps.narrative: Before Sefa leaves, Onesa's issuer assembles their International Patient Summary (problems, medicines, allergies) and signs it with a Document Signer Certificate, as a Verifiable Health Link (HCERT) or SMART Health Link. Sefa's health wallet holds it and can show it as a QR code.

experiences.doing: Receives the signed summary in their wallet and checks it is there.
experiences.feeling: “My health record is coming with me.”

experiences.doing: Assembles the IPS and signs it with a Document Signer Certificate.
Stores the signed summary and renders it as a QR code.

steps.painPoint: A paper summary can be lost, and cannot be checked as genuine abroad.
steps.enabler: The summary is signed with a key that the GDHCN trust list already carries.
